proposed_intervals.basis: EO11884 section 5 immediate whole revocation; no post-revocation revival located in bounded search. This does not assign every clause the same first cessation.

rationale: Official FR 6701-6703 (EO10016, signed November 10, 1948) and FR 47469-47471 (EO11884, signed October 7, 1975) were read including all incorporated illustrations/specifications. EO11884 section 5 expressly revokes EO10016 and makes the order effective immediately, establishing the 1975-10-07 whole revocation rather than the 1975-10-09 publication date. The original prescribes continuing coat-of-arms, seal, flag, incorporated design and exclusive-representation norms, with no own-term sunset, report deadline or contingent end. Its separate revocation of EO7285 is a completed dispositive act under frozen TC07, not continuing EO10016 authority or revival of EO7285. No savings or reserved EO10016 authority appears in EO11884. Both editorial observations and actor supporting note were reviewed as dependent leads, not independent original proof or effective dates. The logged bounded local search found no other named amendment/revival; EO11649 seal-use regulations and 18USC713 have independent authority and EO11544/11926 badge permissions/savings do not preserve EO10016 terms. The historical snapshots are not a current predicate. Recommendation is provisional NO at 2026-10-14; a finite search is not universal coverage or human certification.
